title: Boat Excursion in Florida Keys with Snorkeling Equipment
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Trips are customizable - to a point. Your friendly, knowledgeable guide has experience with all sorts of ocean activities and knows the waters around the Lower Keys really well. So there are a few different areas to choose from on where to go and we can decide based on weather, wind, etc. There is the option to bring up to 2 kayaks ($25 rental fee per kayak). Snorkel equipment available (just let us know in advance sizes). The guide would be glad to hop in and point things out just let him know ahead of time. Possibility of seeing dolphins. We love the ocean and have a passion for being on or under the water! Also we are kid friendly!
